fact.subject: Intel
fact.object: GPU D-Series 推理加速卡参数及送样进展

evidence.quote: At OCP 2026 today, Intel has given Crescent Island a proper name: the Intel GPU D-Series. For the first time, the company also shared a theoretical peak performance target for the chip: 1.3 PFLOPS of FP8. It also disclosed the final memory bandwidth to expect from these AI inference accelerators: 1.5 TB/s. This new information adds to the slow drip of disclosures Intel has made about Crescent Island throughout 2026.

To bring Xe accelerators into the data center, Intel says it’s working with “a broad ecosystem of OEMs, ODMs, neoclouds, independent software vendors, appliance providers, and AI-native companies.” To that end, Intel says customer sampling of GPU D-Series products is in progress, although it didn’t provide any details of a broad launch.

title: Intel's Crescent Island AI accelerator officially powers new GPU D-Series products
displayTitle: Intel 为 Crescent Island 定名 GPU D-Series，披露推理参数
entities: GPU D-Series 推理加速卡参数及送样进展
summary: Intel 在 OCP 2026 将 Crescent Island 推理加速产品定名 GPU D-Series，首次披露 FP8 理论峰值 1.3 PFLOPS 与 1.5 TB/s 内存带宽，称客户送样正在进行。
investorNote: 产品已从路线图进入送样，但可扩展软件栈、客户量产采购和实际吞吐仍是竞争关键。
narrative: Intel 为 Crescent Island 推理芯片正式定名 GPU D-Series，披露 FP8 理论峰值和内存带宽，并称客户送样已经开始。它瞄准风冷 PCIe 服务器和大模型推理；参数与送样说明产品前进了一步，但商业竞争力还取决于软件生态、实际吞吐及客户能否扩大部署。
